rules._comment_phaseReadGate: Phase-read gate blocks Edit/Write/Bash until the current phase's instruction file is read. Falls back to phaseGate.enabled when not set (backwards compat).

testing._comment_discovery: Smart test discovery + SWE-bench dual gate for existing project tests

skillLearning._comment_enabled: When true, skill learning extracts patterns from completed work

plugins._comment_phaseInjection: When true, the UserPromptSubmit hook appends available flow-integrated plugin hints to the phase context prompt
plugins._comment_standaloneBypassTask: When true, standalone-mode plugin matches in /wogi-start skip task creation and invoke the plugin directly

mcpCapabilities._comment_enabled: When true, sub-agents receive MCP capability hints based on their role. Requires CC 2.1.101+ (sub-agent MCP inheritance)

gateTelemetry._comment: Per-gate self-assessment log. Every quality/verification/logic gate appends a structured event to .workflow/state/gate-telemetry.jsonl. See .claude/docs/gate-telemetry.md.
gateTelemetry._comment_rotateSizeBytes: Rotate to archive when the active log exceeds this size (default 10 MB)
gateTelemetry._comment_crossReferenceOnCorrection: When the session-correction detector (Story wf-cc4eb238) flags a user correction, mark prior PASS events from IGR gates on the same task as misses.

intentGroundedReasoning._comment: Intent-Grounded Reasoning (IGR). Default ON 2026-04-13. See .claude/docs/intent-grounded-reasoning.md. To disable: set enabled=false.

externalMemory._comment: Externalized episodic memory (epic-episodic-memory). Routes noisy tool outputs to disk with breadcrumbs; enforces conclusion capture to state files. Default OFF until Wave E measurement. See .workflow/audits/state-coverage-2026-04-15.md.

thresholds._comment: Size thresholds above which tool outputs are externalized to .workflow/memory/.

retention._comment: Lifecycle policy for .workflow/memory/ files. Eviction runs the promotion pipeline first.

exemptions._comment: Paths and tools that should never be externalized regardless of threshold.

capture._comment: Capture-at-task-boundary enforcement. Disabled until conclusion classifier (G4) is built (wf-a3cc5f2a).

telemetry._comment: Per-session token-savings measurement. Needed to validate Wave E flag flip.
